content.title: What time are the Oscars tonight? What channel are the Oscars on?
content.text: March 15, 2026, 11:45 a.m. ETWho will win Best Picture at the Oscars? Will it be the period horror Sinners with an unprecedented 16 nominations? Or will it be One Battle After Another based on the novel Vineland? A total of 10 films have been nominated for Best Picture.When are the Oscars?The 98th Academy Awards will air live at 7 p.m., Eastern Time on March 15, 2026, on ABC and Hulu. The ceremony will take place at the Dolby Theatre in Los Angeles and will be hosted by comedian Conan O’Brien. What are the films nominated for this year’s Oscars?
